scope: Paper/figure presentation extract only; no new partitioning, synthesis, timing, Native or hardware execution. Corrected mapping hashes identify representation repairs with zero ownership changes; Native measurements retain historical scope.

metric_definitions.worst_uncaptured_crossings: Maximum FPGA-boundary changes before a register capture or modeled terminal; lower is better.
metric_definitions.worst_minimum_physical_link_hops: Maximum sum of declared minimum link counts along a modeled uncaptured path; a routing lower bound, not a chosen route.
metric_definitions.extra_crossings_at_endpoints: Sum over capture/terminal endpoints of max(0, that endpoint's worst incoming crossing count minus one); not a count of all paths.
metric_definitions.combinational_transit_cells: Combinational primitives reachable from a cut ingress and able to reach a cut egress within their FPGA without capture; not a path count.
metric_definitions.optimization_transfers: Optimizer's directed structural net-to-FPGA-destination count; narrower than full Native electrical boundary scope and not physical pins.
metric_definitions.native_lut_imbalance_fraction: Maximum original-source Native CLB LUT subset use divided by mean use minus one, for these equal VP1902 targets.
metric_definitions.missing_values: null means not measured or unavailable, never zero; rejected attempts retain their status.

mesh_three_fpga_feedback.scope: Both iterations have actual Native subset resource validation. Only selected iteration 1 carries the final exact boundary proof; this is not a controlled causal ablation of feedback versus seed.

aes_alternatives.scope: Read-only small completed receipts/reports only; selected V5maps are distinct from originalMAIN/coarse/V4alternatives. No native/payload/runtime/lease/Rootpublication action.

scope: 70% is permitted imbalance, not a requested load target. All four devices must contain useful logic and satisfy hard capacity limits.
Native LUT measured rows outside the 70% envelope are explicitly identified, not relabelled qualified mappings.
Rejected attempts contain blank metric columns and do not inherit an earlier candidate's numbers.
Only each selected final mapping and the qualified baseline have the recorded independent Native endpoint/category proof; intermediate rows have Native LUT measurements and emitted cut reports.
T optimizes internal transfers; complete unique data cuts and directed destinations are separately reported and can move in opposite directions.
Default structural rank considers H, C, sampled timing, E, V, envelope, transfers and topology before fine balance. A lower V or fewer cuts alone does not establish a better overall mapping.
The coarse profile changes both hierarchy threshold and cut allowance; this experiment does not isolate one parameter's causal effect or prove a global optimum/routed clock improvement.
